facts.business: Garbi Finvest Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) engaged in lending and investment activities.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided text
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified due to non-compliance with Ind AS for provisioning/expected losses and lack of standardized methodology for interest income recognition. Emphasis on missing loan agreements, incomplete balance confirmations, unavailable payroll records, and unverified write-offs of Rs 4.84 lakh.

key_risks: Inadequate provisioning methodology and non-compliance with Ind AS for expected losses
Interest income recognition based on internal calculations without standardized methodology or system-generated reports
Lack of loan agreements, sanction documents, and credit appraisal records affecting recoverability and classification of loans
Incomplete balance confirmations from customers and borrowers
Unavailability of payroll records and employee benefit documentation affecting Ind AS 19 compliance
Write-offs without adequate supporting documents or approvals
